name: Mock OpenWrt WAN recovery
prompt: Use ubus and logread against the simulated OpenWrt router, then navigate its terminal menu to WAN. Identify the failure and save a safe recovery plan in answer.json.

lab.context: OpenWrt shell menu exposes Network > Interfaces > WAN.

commands.logread -e netifd: netifd: wan (1822): udhcpc: no lease, failing

menus.network>interfaces>wan:
Network > Interfaces > WAN
Protocol DHCP; device eth1; status pending; no address
